job.what: Discovery-owned read-only aggregate probe for afdb-project-cancellation, executing the record's next_action steps (2)+(3) in one pass. (1) Fresh IATI registry inventory from the worker (57 afdb datasets expected, license cc-by on each). (2) Worker-side reachability + bounded extraction of every afdb.org IATI XML resource URL (~57 files, ~140 MB expected): per-file status/bytes/sha256/seconds, one bounded retry per failure, abort at half-blocked. (3) Full-panel aggregate counts from the XML only - counts, no labelled rows, no task construction: status histogram (reconcile vs MapAfrica 230 cancelled / datastore 191), duplicate identifiers, terminal population per approval-year window with both classes for the proposed train<=2000 / eval 2001-2010 / holdout 2011-2023 splits, clustered country x year positive counts, censoring and eligibility accounting for status 1/2 (planned-end backlog), completed/cancelled actual-end presence, type-2-vs-type-1 offset distribution, per-file sha256 pinning the source vintage for construction. (4) IATI ActivityStatus codelist corroboration from a non-gated channel; MapAfrica plain-client control fetch (expected Cloudflare challenge, recorded not retried). Bounds: <=130 HTTP requests, <=400 MB total download, 45 s per request, 12-minute internal deadline inside the 15-minute job. No credentials in the container. Results to stdout (container.log) and /output/summary.json.

note: Conservative reservation, not a provider billing guarantee
